data.title: Iran claims unused modern weapons ready if US resumes attacks | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: An Iranian military source told RIA Novosti that Tehran has domestically produced weapons not yet used in battle, warning Iran would not “act with restraint” if US strikes resume.
